reason: I have heard a version of this before, paid a marketing outfit over a thousand a month for a year and got click reports and no jobs. A free hour and a one-page write-up sounds nice, but I am not giving up a job-day to sit down with another guy who wants to sell me a fix.
objection: The $1,500 to $3,500 fixed price is not the fixed price, it is only decided after I have already given him the hour and the look at how I run things. That is the same setup that got me last time: free diagnosis, then a bill I did not see coming and no way to tell if the work did anything.
would_change_my_mind: He comes to me instead of me going to him, 20 minutes at my shop while I am between calls, and shows me one concrete fix he already did for another shop like mine, with the price printed on it before I open my books.
